task.title: Planner: copy a previous week
task.description:
Owner decision (2026-11-18): wanted.

Wanted:
- On a planner week, 'Copy from…' fills the week from an earlier week, slot for slot by weekday and meal (types, recipes, eat-out and leftovers meals, plain names).
- If the target week already has planned slots, ask first: fill only empty slots, or replace everything.
- Leftovers links are remapped to the copied cooked slots; a link that pointed outside the copied week is dropped, leaving a Leftovers slot with no source.
- Removed recipes copy as a plain name with no recipe attached.

Notes: does not create or update the week's grocery list; the existing 'plan changed' hint covers that. Pair with 'Planner: undo the last change' so a mistaken copy can be reverted.
